title: Read text and page citation usefulness
mustHold: Selected pages return usable text for the requested page set
Citations/chunks can be bound back to the correct page number
Invalid page selection emits ordered warnings or fails closed without inventing pages
mayDiffer: Chunk boundary placement within the same page
Text-item IDs and exact UTF-16 offsets outside claimed families
failClosed: Do not report success for pages that were not readable when all selected pages fail

evidence.notes: Task smoke uses local fixtures; broader corpus thresholds remain future work.
